meta.name: transnetv2-scene-detect
meta.description: TransNetV2-based video scene detection skill. Use when a task needs high-accuracy shot boundary detection, local scene splitting, or downstream video-analysis workflows that depend on the TransNetV2 pipeline.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 精准检测视频镜头边界，自动分割场景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从长视频中自动提取独立镜头片段
copy.tagline_en: Detect video shot boundaries and split scenes with high accuracy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically segment long videos into individual shots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以使用 TransNetV2 模型检测视频中的镜头切换点，生成包含场景边界信息的 JSON 文件，作为视频分析预处理环节。
howto.when: 当你需要高精度的镜头边界检测、局部场景分割，或进行依赖 TransNetV2 的视频分析任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测这个视频中的场景切换点。
say.note: Claude 会运行 TransNetV2 并输出结果。

say.text: 对这段视频进行镜头分割，输出 JSON。
say.note: 会生成 shot 边界数据。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses the TransNetV2 model to detect shot boundaries in video files, producing JSON output of scene cuts as a preprocessing step for video analysis workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need high-accuracy shot boundary detection, local scene splitting, or when running a video analysis workflow that relies on the TransNetV2 pipeline.

say_en.text: Detect scene transitions in this video.
say_en.note: Claude runs TransNetV2 and outputs results.

say_en.text: Split this video into shots and output JSON.
